title: run-postcase-testing
desc: Run-PostCase helper function for testing PostToolUse hook behavior in wkharness self-test suite.
steps: PURPOSE: Run-PostCase is a test helper in wkharness-status.ps1 that calls wkharness-post.ps1 with a JSON payload and checks stderr output for expected patterns.

MECHANISM: Uses ProcessStartInfo to spawn powershell.exe with explicit env var control. Sets WKHARNESS_SELFTEST=empty (post hook returns early if SELFTEST=1), passes JSON via StandardInput, reads StandardError.
powershell ...) inside the test runner produces out.len=0 due to nested process stdin inheritance issues. ProcessStartInfo bypasses this.
PATTERN: Run-PostCase 'label' 'json' 'expectPattern' -> PASS if output matches pattern, PASS if pattern is empty string (no-trigger test).
SCOPE: only tests harness:done and harness:learn PostToolUse behavior. PreToolUse guards use Run-Case instead.

HARNESS:SKILL SELF-TEST CASES (2026-05-27): when adding Run-Case coverage for the harness:skill guard, exercise the isEditOp matrix -- Bash 'wkappbot file edit' and 'wkedit' on a registered csharp path with required skills unread expect exit 2; Read on the same path expects exit 0 (reads never blocked); Write on an unregistered .cs expects exit 2 via catch-all. Pick skill ids guaranteed unread in the test session for deterministic blocks. File lives at tools/wkharness-status.ps1 in personal-docs.

Note (2026-05-27): personal-docs CLAUDE.md has NO harness:skill patterns, so a 'registered path -> block' unit case is not feasible without adding a fixture pattern; that path is covered by live testing instead. Deterministic harness:skill self-test cases that need no fixture: Write on an unregistered .cs -> catch-all block (exit2); Read on a .cs -> allow (exit0, not an edit op). Use session_id empty-string to skip pace and reach Invoke-HarnessRules, mirroring the existing unregistered-Edit case.
Run-Case exit codes: 2=block, 0=allow, -1=any. Empty session_id reaches Invoke-HarnessRules deterministically (pace skipped). Mirror the surrounding case quoting exactly when adding coverage.
